race.comment: Lots of win chances. DIVINE FIRE (6) was outclassed in town last time but did win a race very similar to this two back at Strathalbyn. Gets chance to atone. COLLATED (2) has very similar form. Winner two back at the provincials then safely held at Morphettville last time. Can bounce back. YOROKOBI (7) has been racing well. Narrowly beaten at the provincials two back then runner-up there last time. Deserves to break through. FUWARI (8) is ticking along okay with two runs this time in. Improved last time out when third, beaten 2.5 lengths, at Mt Gambier over 2050m. Looms as a genuine contender. IRLANDAIS (11) is on the quick back-up after racing at Murray Bridge on Wednesday. Winds up strongly and has placed 2/3 here.
